build_DPRDistillTask: build a DPRDistillTask LightningModule for distilling DPR query encoders with MSE loss
run_training_step_DPRDistillTask: run a training step that encodes queries and computes MSE loss against target vectors
run_sim_score_DPRDistillTask: run sim_score to compute cosine similarity scores between query and context representations
run_compute_rank_metrics_DPRDistillTask: run compute_rank_metrics to calculate average rank, MRR, and accuracy@k from prediction scores
run_to_torchscript_DPRDistillTask: run to_torchscript to export the query encoder as a TorchScript model with optional quantization
